**What I checked**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Instance state and status checks | All three are running, with system and instance checks passing and no scheduled events. The instances themselves look healthy. |

| Security group `sg-a8544cd4` (default) | Problem. The only inbound rule allows all traffic from members of the same security group. Nothing allows TCP 22 from your IP or network. |

**Fix**

Add an inbound rule to `sg-a8544cd4` that allows TCP 22 from your public IP, for example `x.x.x.x/32`. Avoid `0.0.0.0/0`.

I can make that change, and you'd approve it before it runs. I need your source IP or CIDR. Because the group is shared, the rule would open SSH on all three instances.
